purpose: Separate local candidate; preserve the original V2 benchmark and do not push to GitHub
forecast_source: The same archived GFS seamless run initialized 2026-11-02T06:00:00+00:00 as original V2

variants.catboost_base_full: V2 annual fixed-day training pairs with earlier exact runs preferred; GFS temperature/humidity/rain, local-hour sine/cosine, forecast-day band
variants.catboost_base_exact: Same six predictors, exact archived weekly runs only; matched training-row control for history features
variants.catboost_history_exact: Exact same training rows as base_exact, adding issue-time station history, age, complete rain sums, coverage and errors from previously issued forecasts

feature_issue_policy: History requires a known exact issue. Measurements, availability times and nominal target times must be at/before that issue. Historical receipt time is measurement plus one hour, inherited from V2. Prior forecast issues must precede the current issue. A week-long frozen forecast gets one initial context, never future actual updates.
station_history_policy: Latest station values expire after six hours; age/coverage remain explicit. Trailing 3/6/12/24-hour summaries are anchored on the latest available hour. Rain sums require every constituent hour; no missing-to-zero fill. Recent errors use only previously issued exact weekly forecasts and then-available observations.
temperature_humidity: CatBoost MAE regression of observation minus GFS; humidity clipped to 0–100
rain: CatBoost Logloss occurrence plus RMSE positive-amount regression; expected rain = probability times nonnegative conditional amount (minimum 0.28 mm when wet)
tuning: One predeclared CatBoost configuration, no early stopping or hyperparameter search; October comparison selects component methods only
selection: Per station and variable over all seven forecast days: smallest October MAE for temperature/humidity, RMSE for rain amount, Brier score for hourly probability; compare raw, original V2 validation recipe and all CatBoost variants. Ties favor the original V2. Rain amount and probability can select different variants and are not a full coherent joint distribution.
baseline_comparison: Reconstruct original V2's selected recipes using only pre-October fits for October rows. Never evaluate October with the final V2 parameters trained through November 2. Original V2 recipe selection and CatBoost component selection both use October; all October scores are validation, not a new untouched test.
forecast_lead_limit: Forecast-day bands are inherited from V2; annual proxy rows have unknown exact issue times. All exact weekly issues are midnight WIB. No improvement for arbitrary rolling issue times or spatial transfer is established.
joint_window_probability: Unavailable for 6/12/24 hours; never add hourly probabilities
new_actuals: Post-cutoff observations remain withheld; later scoring verifies hashes and never fits or changes models
station_policy: Separate station models. X51/X67 without October support retain raw GFS and unavailable probability. X66 retains user-selected t/h and its sensor discrepancy flag.
